content:
One of the goals of this Zulip is to build a friendly, welcoming community of humans interacting to discuss the formalisation of mathematics, computer science, physics, etc. in Lean. On behalf of the Zulip moderators, let me emphasize that it is counterproductive to this goal to use the robot emoji :robot: to label messages as "this is AI-generated or low quality AI slop" (hence violating the community guidelines):

  • If the message is indeed AI-generated or about AI slop, it violates the community guidelines, and acting on it quickly is helpful. Using the robot emoji instead of the "report message" feature is counterproductive: reporting the message directly notifies the moderators, which the bot emoji does not.
  • If the message is not, the robot emoji creates a hostile signal of "you're not welcome here". That's not the community spirit we want.

Therefore, please do not use the robot emoji for this purpose.

Thank you for the message, this bothered me a lot when I saw its use in this way (not that I'm pro-AI use, just not sure the robot emoji is the best way to deal with this). It also is used for other purposes and creates a lot of misunderstandings, wasted time, and hostility as the authors respond defensively to the accusation / misunderstanding.
